中音聲部，音域介於曼陀林與曼陀大提琴之間；填補旋律與低音之間的縫隙: The alto part, its range between the mandolin and the mandocello; it fills the gap between melody and bass
主旋律；長音以輪指（tremolo）維持，快速段落用單音撥奏: Main melody; long notes sustained by tremolo, fast passages played with single plucked notes
依樂團與曲目增減，用來補足撥弦缺乏的持續音與音色: Added or dropped depending on the orchestra and the piece, to make up for the sustain and colour the plucked strings lack
先和俄羅斯民族樂團分開。兩者都是撥弦樂團，都用快速輪撥代替弓，也都在低音區吃虧。: Start by separating it from the Russian folk orchestra. Both are plucked-string orchestras, both use fast tremolo instead of the bow, and both suffer in the bass. The difference is where the family comes from and how the bass is handled: the mandolin orchestra's ranges are almost a copy of the string orchestra's — first mandolin to mandocello match violin to cello — and the true contrabass has to be borrowed from the double bass; in the Russian orchestra the domra and balalaika form their own family, a contrabass balalaika exists but decays fast, and sustained harmony comes from the bayan, the one instrument that can hold a chord for a long time.
先聽輪指。注意旋律是不是由一連串極快的撥弦組成；輪指的速度與均勻度，是這個編制最: Listen to the tremolo first. Notice whether the melody is made of a string of extremely fast plucks; the speed and evenness of the tremolo is the most central technique of this line-up.
分擔旋律、演奏三度與六度平行聲部、提供和聲節奏: Shares the melody, plays parallel thirds and sixths, supplies harmonic rhythm
另一個結構特徵是：曼陀林樂團的曲目大量來自改編。弦樂四重奏、弦樂小夜曲、歌劇序曲: Another structural feature is that a large part of the mandolin orchestra's repertoire comes from arrangements. String quartets, string serenades, opera overtures, film scores and pop songs can all be moved over; original works are relatively few. What most needs rewriting is long notes and the breathing of phrases — the crescendos and continuity once drawn out with the bow have to become changes of tremolo density and a redistribution among the parts. This is also why the same string work sounds brighter and more fragmented in a mandolin orchestra, and why it has a harder time holding tension in slow passages.
各聲部的人數沒有固定標準。小型團可能每個聲部兩三人，大型業餘團的第一曼陀林可以坐: There is no fixed standard for the number of players in each part. A small group may have two or three per part; in a large amateur orchestra the first mandolins can fill a whole row. This design of many players on the same part is not only for volume: several mandolins trembling at once produce slight phase differences, and the sound becomes thick and shimmering. This is the most recognisable sonority of a mandolin orchestra.
和絃樂四重奏相比，差別在編制規模與持續音的手段。兩者的樂器調弦相同，同一份弦樂總: Compared with a string quartet, the difference is the size of the line-up and the means of sustaining notes. The instruments are tuned the same, and the same string score can be moved over almost as it stands; but a quartet has one player per part, no conductor, and long notes held directly by the bow. A mandolin orchestra can have a whole row on each part, with the conductor unifying the tremolo density and the attack, and long notes are a chain of short plucked notes joined together.
在德國與奧地利，撥弦樂團（Zupforchester）是社團與音樂學校的固定編制: In Germany and Austria the plucked orchestra (Zupforchester) is a fixture of clubs and music schools, with a very dense amateur scene and a repertoire running from Renaissance lute consorts to contemporary originals. In Italy the mandolin orchestra is tied to opera and to the folk-song tradition, and is still common at local festivals and church occasions. In Japan there are a great many university, corporate and community mandolin clubs, whose main activity is the regular concert and the ensemble competition, with a repertoire leaning towards arranged classics and film music. In North America, classical mandolin societies link community orchestras around the continent into a network made up mostly of amateur players.
它有一套完整的聲部：第一與第二曼陀林、曼陀拉、曼陀大提琴、吉他與低音，音域與分工: It has a full set of parts: first and second mandolins, mandola, mandocello, guitar and bass, with ranges and roles matching a string orchestra. Treat it as everyone playing in unison and you will not hear the design of the middle and the bass.
德國與日本的業餘撥弦樂團密度很高，日本的大學與企業社團、德國的 Zupforch: Amateur plucked orchestras are very dense in Germany and Japan; Japanese university and corporate clubs and German Zupforchester groups each have their own repertoire and competition tradition. It is a cross-border amateur ensemble movement, not just a local tradition of Italy.
找社團的現場錄音。曼陀林樂團的空間感與人數帶來的厚度，在近距離錄音裡最明顯。: Find a live recording by a club. A mandolin orchestra's sense of space, and the thickness that numbers bring, are clearest in a close recording.
提供和弦、節奏型與穩定的低音；在大型樂團裡常有多把: Supplies chords, rhythm patterns and a steady bass; large orchestras often have several
撐根音與低音線；曼陀大提琴是主力，真正的倍低音常借用低音提琴: Holds the root and the bass line; the mandocello is the mainstay, and the true contrabass is usually borrowed from the double bass
撥弦樂器有一個無法迴避的物理事實：一個音撥下去之後只會衰減，不會維持。弦樂團的長: A plucked instrument faces an unavoidable physical fact: once a note is plucked it only decays, it does not sustain. A string orchestra sustains long notes by feeding energy continuously with the bow; the mandolin orchestra has no such means, so it developed the tremolo — striking the same string again and again with a pick at great speed so that a series of short attacks sounds like a line. The tremolo is not an ornament; it is this line-up's bow. That also decides how the orchestra plays: the melodic parts are trembling almost the whole time, and the speed has to match, or the same melody will sound like many people each shaking on their own.
撥片的選擇也影響整個樂團的平衡。硬撥片起音清楚、泛音多，適合快速的旋律；軟撥片起: The choice of pick also affects the whole orchestra's balance. A hard pick gives a clear attack and many overtones, good for fast melody; a soft pick gives a round attack and slower decay, good for slow tremolo. If one part mixes picks of different hardness the sound splits into two layers at once. Professional and semi-professional orchestras therefore require a uniform pick within a part, even a uniform angle of crossing the string. The same goes for string material: metal strings are bright and project well, gut or composite strings are warm and short, and the mandolin orchestra prefers metal strings precisely because they project and carry in a concert hall.
曲目因此分成幾塊：改編的古典（弦樂小夜曲、協奏曲、歌劇序曲）、原創的曼陀林管弦作: The repertoire therefore divides into several blocks: arranged classics (string serenades, concertos, opera overtures), original works for mandolin orchestra, arrangements of film and pop music, and the folk songs and dances of various countries. Concerts are usually a club's regular recital rather than a professional season.
曼陀林樂團就是很多把曼陀林一起彈，沒有聲部分工。: A mandolin orchestra is just a lot of mandolins played together, with no division into parts.
曼陀林樂團是義大利的民俗現象，其他地方只是模仿。: The mandolin orchestra is an Italian folk phenomenon; everywhere else is just imitation.
曼陀林樂團（Mandolin Orchestra）— 以曼陀林家族與吉他組成、用: Mandolin Orchestra — a plucked-string orchestra of the mandolin family and guitars, using tremolo in place of the bow. Ensembles and instrumentation by Next Door Sound Weavers.
曼陀林樂團（mandolin orchestra）是把曼陀林家族按弦樂四重奏的音: A mandolin orchestra lays out the mandolin family by the ranges of a string quartet and adds guitar and bass to make a plucked-string ensemble. First mandolin, second mandolin, mandola, mandocello, guitar, bass — this row of parts is almost a string orchestra, except that everything is set in motion with a pick. It has a steady amateur and semi-professional scene in Italy, Germany, Japan and North America, and Japanese university and corporate mandolin clubs are especially dense.
曼陀林的輪指是一種裝飾技巧，可用可不用。: The mandolin's tremolo is a decorative technique that you may or may not use.
編制的邏輯很直接：把弦樂團的五個聲部換成撥弦樂器。曼陀林與小提琴同為 G–D–A: The logic of the line-up is direct: replace the string orchestra's five parts with plucked instruments. The mandolin and the violin share the G–D–A–E fifths tuning, the mandola is a fifth lower, the mandocello an octave below that, so the same string score can be moved over almost as it stands.
聽低音。曼陀大提琴是撥的，低音線會有明顯的顆粒；注意樂團怎麼用吉他或低音提琴補。: Listen to the bass. The mandocello is plucked, so the bass line has obvious grain; notice how the orchestra fills it with guitar or double bass.
聽聲部之間的音色差。第一曼陀林亮、曼陀拉較暗、曼陀大提琴厚，這三層的分界比弦樂團: Listen to the difference in timbre between the parts. The first mandolin is bright, the mandola darker, the mandocello thick, and the boundary between these three layers is clearer than in a string orchestra.
聽起音的整齊度。同一個和弦，十幾把琴是不是在同一個瞬間發聲；不整齊時會出現沙沙的: Listen to how together the attacks are. For the same chord, do a dozen instruments sound at the same instant; when they are not together you get a rustling noise.
與藍草樂隊相比，差別在誰管時間、以及曼陀林做什麼。藍草沒有指揮，拍子由低音提琴與: Compared with a bluegrass band, the difference is who keeps time and what the mandolin does. Bluegrass has no conductor; the beat is set by the double bass and by the mandolin's chop on beats two and four, and the mandolin is a rhythm and solo instrument. A mandolin orchestra reads parts and has a conductor, the mandolins carry the melody, and the tremolo is what lengthens the note.
輪指是這個編制的持續音手段，功能等於弦樂的弓。沒有輪指，慢速旋律無法連貫，整個樂: The tremolo is this line-up's means of sustaining notes, with the same function as the string player's bow. Without tremolo a slow melody cannot be continuous, and the whole orchestra's long notes and harmony break off.
輪指的第二個問題是起音的同步。撥片的起音非常短，短到只有幾毫秒；十幾把曼陀林如果: The second problem with tremolo is synchronising the attack. A pick's attack is very short, only a few milliseconds; if a dozen mandolins do not cross the string at the same instant, what you hear is a blur of rustling rather than a note. A large part of a mandolin orchestra's rehearsal therefore goes on starting together: the angle, depth and string-crossing time of the right-hand pick have to be unified, and the breathing within a part has to match. This demand for precision is closer to a percussion ensemble than to a string orchestra.
音域上，曼陀林家族加吉他可以覆蓋弦樂團的大部分音域，但最低音仍然不足。曼陀大提琴: In range, the mandolin family plus guitar can cover most of a string orchestra's range, but the lowest notes are still missing. The mandocello's bass is plucked and decays fast; the true contrabass is usually borrowed from the double bass. So, as with the Chinese and Korean orchestras, the bass is a borrowed layer — only here the borrowing is more natural, because the difference between plucked and bowed strings in the bass register is less obvious.
音量是第三個問題。曼陀林的琴身小、弦短、共鳴有限，一把琴的聲音在音樂廳裡傳不遠。: Volume is the third problem. The mandolin has a small body, short strings and limited resonance, and one instrument's sound does not carry far in a concert hall. The orchestra's answer is to add players, use metal strings, double the mandocello and guitar, and amplify when necessary. But the more players there are, the more obvious the phase differences in the tremolo become, and the sound turns from a clear line into a sheet of sheen. This is the mandolin orchestra's trade-off: clarity and thickness are hard to maximise at the same time.
